title: vibhaṅga sutta
credit: Pāḷi text and English translation as in Mor’s Pāḷi Workshop booklet.

paras.en: “Bhikkhus, I will teach you the establishment of awareness, and the development of the establishment of awareness, and the way leading to the development of the establishment of awareness. Listen to that.

And what, bhikkhus, is the establishment of awareness? Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu dwells observing the body as body, ardent, clearly comprehending, aware, having removed craving and aversion in regard to the world.
He dwells observing vedanā as vedanā …
mind as mind … phenomena as phenomena, ardent, clearly comprehending, aware,
having removed craving and aversion in regard
to the world.
This is called the establishment of awareness.

And what, bhikkhus, is the development of the establishment of awareness? Here, bhikkhus,
a bhikkhu dwells observing the nature of origination in the body; he dwells observing the nature of vanishing in the body; he dwells observing the nature of origination and vanishing in the body — ardent,
clearly comprehending, aware, having removed craving and aversion in regard to the world.

He dwells observing the nature of origination in vedanā … He dwells observing the nature of origination in mind … He dwells observing the nature of origination in phenomena; he dwells observing the nature of vanishing in phenomena;
he dwells observing the nature of origination and vanishing in phenomena — ardent, clearly comprehending, aware, having removed craving and aversion in regard to the world. This is called the development of the establishment of awareness.

And what, bhikkhus, is the way leading to the development of the establishment of awareness?
It is this Noble Eightfold Path; that is,
right view, right intention,
right speech, right action, right livelihood,
right effort, right awareness, right concentration.
This is called the way leading to the development of the establishment of awareness.”
